steps.call: Climb either mid-island tower. During the warning, zoom out and turn toward the ocean. Capture as the foam crest reaches the beach.
Catch and place three of the same species on separate pads, then frame the fused brainrot alongside another placed brainrot.
Wait at the ocean end of the belt during the warning. Press E to catch, then run toward the bases. Turn the camera back toward the ocean while you run.
